card.name: Дом заговорщиков
card.description: Раз в ход тайно выберите персонажа для сброса в следующем раунде

userFeedback: Концепт хороший: стол, темнота, свечи, капюшоны. Добавь больше мрачности, сделай отсылку на персонажей Вор и Лавочник, Император (он может быть как жертва). Ракурс сделай немного ближе к центру стола. Перегенерируй с нуля

fromScratchIntent.operation: New generation from scratch with five designated reference images
fromScratchIntent.intent: Darker secret meeting, camera closer to centre of table, identifiable Thief and Shopkeeper conspiring against Emperor portrait

generation.promptFileTrailingNewline: Saved file has one terminal newline; call prompt otherwise identical

references.role: Primary district full face geometry, parchment, lower ribbon, black Cyrillic serif, purple medallion and painted texture
Exactly six vertical gold coin emblems only; no geometry
Thief visual identity only: youthful face, straight dark hair, navy hood, cool palette
Shopkeeper visual identity only: bald elderly head, white side hair/eyebrows, spectacles, ochre sleeves, dark vest, pale scarf
Emperor visual identity only for tabletop portrait: dark skin, short curly black hair/beard, gold crown, white/gold/burgundy costume

visualChecks.method: Direct visual inspection of tool result and saved PNG via view_image

ability.observed: Раз в ход тайно выберите персонажа для сброса в следующем раунде

characterReferences.thief: Young straight-dark-haired figure at left with navy hood and silver forearm guard, pointing at target portrait
characterReferences.shopkeeper: Elderly bald figure at right, white side hair/eyebrows, spectacles, ochre sleeves, dark vest and pale scarf
characterReferences.emperor: Large central tabletop portrait: dark skin, short curly black hair and beard, gold crown, white/gold/red costume
characterReferences.limitation: Recognizable visual adaptations, not pixel-identical faces

closerTable.observed: Table and large Emperor portrait fill foreground; large faces and hands with slightly downward view, minimal distant room

darkerScene.observed: Deep navy/charcoal shadow around three conspirators; candle pools on faces/table, light parchment remains readable
darkerScene.basis: Qualitative visual assessment, not measured luminance comparison

fullCard.observed: Complete rectangular edge-to-edge face, readable parchment/ribbon/medallion, no mockup or external border

noViolence.observed: Emperor appears alive in portrait; no blood, bodies, weapons or violence

limitations: Faces and costume details are generative adaptations of the three character references.
The anonymous third hooded figure is large in the rear but remains in shadow.
Additional table cards have indistinct silhouettes; the plan has geometric marks and red route arrows, no readable words or numbers.
Coin count and exact Russian text checked visually, not by OCR.
Final geometry, lower text alignment, JPEG conversion and file-size work await artistic approval.
projectChanges: Only v2 PNG, prompt and metadata; no prior-version overwrite, catalog changes, public original replacements, commit or push.

subsequentUserFeedback.statement: Концепт хорош. Однако портрет короля огромный и лежит по центру. Пусть фото императора лежит сбоку маленькой картинкой. Пусть будет не 3, а 4 заговорщика. Вора мы видим спереди, Лавочника убираем, видим сбоку Патриция, лица немного различимы, но немного, и не всех. По центру у них лежит схема дворца. Перегенерируй с нуля
